detail: Full summary: The drop is NOT a missing-feature/version gap. ab48f81 (which introduced rationale_source) is an ancestor of the 2.6.0 tag 20ec0ef, and the marketplace bundle at ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/twining-marketplace/plugin/server/twining-server.mjs contains the whole chain including the forwarding spread 'rationale_source ? { rationale_source: input.rationale_source } : {}'. Source path also looks correct end to end: record-tools.ts:95 and :140 set it, decisions.ts:354 forwards it, sqlite-stores.ts:167 spreads input, record-export.ts:93 writes the decision verbatim. So the live behaviour contradicts what the code at HEAD does — one of those layers is not the code actually running.
